item.title: Yes, it's possible to save money while paying off credit card debt. Here's how

item.description: Democrats are making the case that now is the time to tackle anti-corruption reforms — to serve as a check on Donald Trump and to overhaul a system voters say is co-opted against their interests.

item.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
item.description: The meeting comes as both face pressures at home. Netanyahu is up for reelection, embattled in part due to his deteriorating relationship with Trump. Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war.

item.title: With wildfires raging in France and Spain, fire crews race against next heat wave
item.description: French authorities ordered nearly 4,000 people evacuated Tuesday from tourist sites on the Atlantic coast as returning heat threatened firefighters' fragile hold on a vast wildfire west of Bordeaux.
